# Repository Guidelines

## Agent bootstrap

Read `.ai/rules/common.md`, `.ai/service.yaml`, `docs/README.md`, and the affected ingestion, HTTP/WebSocket, storage, or runtime contract before changing files. Production code, migrations, tests, and repository-owned documentation are authoritative.

## Architecture invariants

- This service owns coding-telemetry ingestion and user-scoped task summaries in ClickHouse. It does not own users, courses, lessons, tasks, sessions, or authorization policy.
- Keep domain/use-case code independent from Echo, Gorilla WebSocket, ClickHouse, NATS, and concrete logging. Transport and infrastructure implement ports; `cmd/ms-go-statistic/main.go` is the composition root.
- `course_id`, `lesson_id`, and `task_id` are opaque UUID references. The legacy `course_version_id` column remains in ClickHouse but current requests do not accept it and inserts write the zero UUID.
- HTTP and WebSocket identity currently trusts gateway-provided `X-User-Id` and `X-User-Role`; there is no local token verification or role authorization. Summaries are scoped only by the supplied user UUID.
- A successful ingest response means accepted into the in-memory channel, not durably committed. Preserve the documented partial-acceptance and loss-on-flush-error behavior unless the task explicitly changes the delivery contract.
- Event types are the fixed allowlist in `internal/domain/event.go`. Payload is arbitrary JSON stored as a string; do not infer a stable payload schema.
- WebSocket uses the same use case as HTTP, but currently allows every Origin and has no explicit message-size/read-deadline guard.
- ClickHouse schema and summary SQL are contracts. Reading/solving durations are heuristic projections derived from event timestamps, not authoritative student progress.

## Verification and delivery

- Use `.ai/commands.yaml`; run agent-policy, tracked-file formatting, `go vet`, tests, and both service/migration builds.
- Ingestion, summary, identity, schema, buffer, or HTTP/WebSocket changes require focused regression tests and synchronized owned documentation.
- Do not start Docker/ClickHouse, apply or roll back migrations, call a gateway, or run live E2E scenarios without approval. The current down task removes volumes; rollback is destructive.
